newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares slide, Monday seen quiet.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares slide, Monday seen quiet.

text.p: 1745 GMT - Portuguese shares slid to a lower close despite the firmer tone on other European bourses. Dealers said much of the selling was the result of investors tidying up portfolio positions before the end of the year and they expected Monday to be quieter. Trade focussed on blue-chips.
*PSI20 index .PSI20 lost 0.31 percent to end at 4,941.09 points.
*BCP dominated trade, ending 10 escudos higher at 2,005 with 635,620 shares traded.
*Portugal Telecom (PT) fell 40 esc to 4,120 on volume of 352,891.
*Cimpor was down 14 esc at 3,260 with 209,116 shares traded. Analysts expect the stock to rise by between five and 10 percent before the end of the year due to strong demand for cement.
*BPSM closed down 8 esc at 1,041 on turnover of 171,529.
